preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(A, str) and 1 <= len(A) <= 1000 and A.islower() and A.isalpha() for A in test_cases_A)
preconditions.description: For each test case, string A consists of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(B, str) and 1 <= len(B) <= 1000 and B.islower() and B.isalpha() for B in test_cases_B)
preconditions.description: For each test case, string B consists of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 10000 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(S, str) and 1 <= len(S) <= 26 and S.islower() and S.isalpha() and isinstance(b, int) and 1 <= b <= 100000 for S, b in patterns) for patterns in test_cases_patterns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every pattern string S consists of lowercase English letters with length 1 to 26, and its beauty b is an integer between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(S for S, b in patterns)) == len(patterns) for patterns in test_cases_patterns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all pattern strings S are pairwise distinct.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(A) for A in test_cases_A) <= 2000 and sum(len(B) for B in test_cases_B) <= 2000 and sum(N for N in test_cases_N) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The sum of lengths of A, B, and N across all test cases does not exceed 2000, 2000, and 20000 respectively.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a single non-negative integer representing the maximum pleasure.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max_pleasure(test_cases_A[i], test_cases_B[i], test_cases_patterns[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output integer equals the maximum possible pleasure achievable by choosing any substring As of A and any substring Bs of B, concatenating them to form C = As + Bs, and calculating the sum of (count of Si in C) * bi for all i.
